scenes.summary: Ethan Thorne endures years of unjust imprisonment, a once-respected lawyer reduced to despair, culminating in the crushing news of his family's death upon his release.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: worn, drab prison uniform, later ill-fitting, faded civilian clothes upon release

environment_notes: A grim, decaying modern urban state prison, where Ethan spent years stripped of his former life and prestige, reflecting years of despair and loss.

identity_notes: Ethan Thorne, a once-renowned, ruthlessly efficient top-tier lawyer in a modern urban setting, whose life is shattered by betrayal and tragedy. Now utterly devastated and broken, on the brink of losing all hope.

global_style_notes: Gritty, dark, neo-noir drama set in a modern-urban world, emphasizing the devastating consequences of betrayal and loss, with elements of animation.

scene_end.turn: Ethan, a shell of his former self, walks out of prison into the grim modern-urban world, only to receive a letter confirming the deaths of his wife and daughter, shattering his last vestiges of hope.
scene_end.emotional_shift: From numb despair to utter, heart-wrenching devastation and hopelessness.

shots.text: ETHAN THORNE, gaunt and hollow-eyed in a grimy prison cell, stares blankly at the wall, a ghost of his former self. Years of despair etched onto his face.
shots.visual_goal: Depict Ethan's profound despair and the agonizing passage of time within the prison.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's vacant expression and the starkness of his cell.

shots.text: CLOSE UP on ETHAN's hands, now calloused and rough, slowly turning the yellowed pages of a worn legal textbook. A stark contrast to his past.

camera.framing_notes: Focus on the texture and detail of his hands

shots.visual_goal: Highlight the physical toll of imprisonment and the fading memory of his legal career.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's hands and the worn textbook.

shots.text: ETHAN, a gaunt figure in ill-fitting civilian clothes, walks out of the imposing prison gates into a grim, grey modern-urban world. He is technically free, but spiritually broken.

camera.framing_notes: Emphasizing the daunting scale of the prison and the vastness of the outside world

shots.visual_goal: Show Ethan's release and the physical manifestation of his years of suffering.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's isolated figure against the backdrop of the grim prison.

shots.text: A prison guard hands ETHAN a crumpled, official-looking letter. Ethan's vacant expression flickers with a hint of dread as he takes it.

camera.framing_notes: Focus on the exchange and Ethan's subtle reaction

shots.visual_goal: Introduce the catalyst for Ethan's ultimate devastation.
shots.action_focus: The letter being passed, Ethan's face.

shots.text: CLOSE UP on ETHAN's face. He reads the letter, his eyes widening in horror, then crumples it in a raw, guttural cry that seems to tear from his soul. His last vestiges of hope die.

camera.framing_notes: Intense focus on his facial expression and the emotional breakdown

shots.visual_goal: Convey Ethan's utter devastation and the final shattering of his hope.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's face contorting in agony, the crumpled letter.

scenes.summary: Ethan inexplicably awakens ten years in the past on a rainy city street, his younger body now housing the vengeful memories of his ruined future, solidifying his cold resolve.

character_wardrobe_notes.wardrobe: modern urban business attire, now soaking wet from the rain

environment_notes: A dimly lit, perpetually wet modern urban street in the financial district, ten years in the past, serving as the pivotal location for Ethan's temporal awakening, reflecting a neo-noir atmosphere.

identity_notes: Ethan Thorne, now in his younger body but with the full, devastating memories of his future, driven by a cold, calculating desire for revenge against his betrayers in a modern urban world. He is a man reborn for vengeance.
wardrobe_notes: modern urban business attire, soaked by rain

global_style_notes: Gritty, dark, vengeful neo-noir thriller set in a modern-urban world, focusing on rebirth and time-travel for calculated revenge, with elements of animation.

scene_end.turn: As the rain falls, Ethan's initial confusion morphs into a chilling clarity; the ghost of his lost family fuels a cold, ruthless determination. He looks at his reflection in a puddle, a man reborn, not for redemption, but for meticulously planned, devastating revenge.
scene_end.emotional_shift: From confusion and painful memory to cold, unflinching, vengeful determination.

shots.text: A wide, sweeping view of a bustling modern urban street at night, slick with rain. Neon signs reflect distortedly on the wet pavement, creating a vibrant yet melancholic atmosphere.

camera.framing_notes: Establish the neo-noir, modern urban setting

shots.visual_goal: Establish the 'past' setting, its atmospheric mood, and hint at the bustling world Ethan has returned to.
shots.action_focus: The rain-slicked street, urban lights, and the general ambience.

shots.text: ETHAN (his younger self, but with intense, disoriented eyes) awakens abruptly in a doorway, clutching his head in the relentless downpour. He looks around wildly, confused by his surroundings.

camera.framing_notes: Focus on Ethan's initial disorientation and vulnerability

shots.visual_goal: Convey the shock and disorientation of Ethan's temporal awakening.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's confused actions and panicked gaze.

shots.text: CLOSE UP on ETHAN's rain-streaked eyes. A rapid, disorienting montage of vivid flashes: prison bars, his wife and daughter's smiling faces, the crumpled letter. He recognizes the street, the painful truth dawning.

camera.framing_notes: Highlight the internal struggle and flashback imagery

shots.visual_goal: Show the overwhelming influx of memories from his shattered future colliding with his present.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's eyes, reflecting pain and dawning realization.

shots.text: ETHAN stands, rain running down his face, looking into a large puddle. His reflection, though younger, now carries a chilling, hardened glint in its eyes. The ghost of vengeance fully inhabits his being.

camera.framing_notes: Emphasize the reflection and the symbolic rebirth

shots.visual_goal: Symbolize Ethan's transformation from broken man to vengeful architect of fate.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's reflection in the puddle, the chilling intensity in his eyes.

shots.text: ETHAN steps forward, purposeful and resolute, blending into the blurred lights of the modern urban street. The rain falls like a cleansing baptism, yet his expression is cold, his mission clear: revenge.

camera.framing_notes: Show Ethan moving forward with a sense of destiny

shots.visual_goal: Convey Ethan's acceptance of his new purpose and his unwavering resolve for vengeance.
shots.action_focus: Ethan's determined stride, the symbolic rain, the urban backdrop.
